- Tip-minted Nodes (skeleton): N-594, N-595, N-596, N-10824, N-10825, N-10827

The host says she believes she has "solved the mystery of the tarmac hug." She plays a September 10 Provo police scanner recording in which an officer says he and Sergeant Dupey are en route to Provo Airport because the "victim's wife is arriving at 3:30" (A-2525.1). From this she argues that Erika Kirk did not wait on the Provo tarmac until about 4:30–4:40 p.m. for Andrew Kolvet. Drawing on her own texts and a recorded call with Kolvet (A-2526), she theorizes that Kolvet flew alone from Santa Barbara to Scottsdale shortly after the shooting, that the hug took place at Scottsdale Airport, and that the TPUSA group then flew to Provo together on Charlie Kirk's plane. A Baron Coleman clip argues that Kolvet's departure time could indicate foreknowledge (A-2527.1). The host walks through her updated minute-by-minute timeline (A-2528.1) and asks for tips on Charlie Kirk's pilot, whom she knows only as "Jamie."

The host then returns to Erika Kirk's first New York Times interview (A-2530.1). She says it wrongly placed Erika in the hospital with her mother, and she disputes that the mother was in hospital on September 8–10. She also points to the article's line that Charlie Kirk "was pronounced dead as she was airborne," which she says conflicts with what Erika told her in person and with Elizabeth McCoy's account. She notes that an October Instagram post by Elizabeth McCoy (A-2532.1) described comforting a new widow "on a plane."

In the second segment the host plays comedian Druski's viral skit mocking conservative women, which she says targets Erika Kirk (A-2533). She also shows reactions to it: a Grok reply that misidentified Erika as the actress, a Ted Cruz post calling the skit "beneath contempt," and Kolvet's comment "Now do conservative black women." Returning to Fort Huachuca, she restates Mitch Snow's account and airs Baron Coleman's tracking of a plane he says is frequently used by TPUSA, tail number N582MM (A-2527.2). Coleman says the plane flew Pierre–Chicago–Provo on September 10, spent October 4 at Fort Huachuca and then went to Kalispell, Montana. The host corrects Coleman's guess that Charlie Kirk's parents were aboard, saying they flew on Air Force Two.

In the comments segment, the host addresses Stacy Sheridan's residence in the Kirks' complex and Kolvet's handling of the leaked text message. She also rebuts an online allegation about her husband (A-2536.1), mentions an unverified tip that Frank Turek changed his schedule before September 8, and notes that Tyler Robinson has not yet been arraigned.

lines: - **Artifacts verbally referenced but not shown**: A-2529.1 (TPUSA cease and desist), A-2531.1 (Erika Kirk's Instagram video of her mother), A-2534.1 (Scott Bessent letter) and A-2536.1 (online piece and insurance claim about the host's husband; the host says it will be shown next week).

- **Date discrepancy**: the host dates Erika Kirk's frail-mother Instagram post to September 8 ("2 days before"), while prior claim C-6105 and node N-10446 date it September 7. C-7533 is linked as Supports C-6105 on the shared proposition; the date difference is preserved.

- **Name matching**: "Elizabeth McCord" (19:56, 20:52) and "Elizabeth McCoy" (15:29) are both mapped to N-217 Eliza McCoy (alias Elizabeth McCoy). The context (the airport story and Mikey McCoy's wife) indicates the same person, but McCord may be a transcription error. "Cat" (14:28) and "Katherine Locastro" (15:29) are treated as one new person, N-597. Episodes 083, 085 and 086 spell her LoCastro, LaCastro and Low Castro, but she has no row in nodes.tsv, so the integrator should dedupe. "Marina Minas" is matched to N-493 Marina (TPUSA CMO) through its alias.

- **Transcription ambiguities**: The comedian is spelled "Druski", "Druski" and "Druski"; these are kept as written and aliased to N-594 Druski. Kolvet appears as "Andrew Kolvet" and "Andrew Kolvets". The tail number is first read as "N28 9 MM" and then corrected on air to N582MM. The scanner line "2J436 436" is a unit or cruiser identifier per the host. "Sergeant Dupey" spelling is unverified.
- **Timing ambiguity**: the host says Kolvet was "on the flight that landed at 4:30 p. m." (05:56) but elsewhere says "about 4:40 p. m." (02:15) and "4:36 plane" (14:28). All are preserved as spoken.
- **Not inscribed as claims (admission test)**: Several statements fail falsifiability or rhetoric removal:
- Baron Coleman's conditional "if Andrew left Santa Barbara before Charlie got shot, there was a plot to kill Charlie Kirk and Andrew knew about it" (kept as artifact A-2527.1 only)
- "He's big mad cuz he's getting exposed"
- Characterizations of Erika Kirk's conduct as "AI response" or not like a grieving widow
- The "black magic"/"gangstalk" characterizations of TPUSA critics
- Rhetorical questions about why TPUSA will not answer questions

- **Minor factual beats not inscribed**: the host was mocked on Saturday Night Live and in a Dave Chappelle skit; Charlie Kirk celebrated South Park's parody of him; Mikey McCoy did interviews from Charlie's office; the host corrected a Nick Shirley timeline; Charlie Kirk's position on Israel had shifted before he died; and the military enlistment age is rising from 35 to 42 in April. The host also says she suspects Charlie was looking at Frank Turek before a Laura Ingraham ("Laura Ingraham") interview.
- **Sponsor reads** (Nick Nac, PureTalk, BlockTrust IRA) and merch promotion are excluded.
